title: The Day of the Lord Is Coming
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: This is the last chapter of the last letter of a man who knows he is about to die, and he ends it looking straight at the horizon. Eight weeks ago Peter opened with a living hope. This week he tells you where that hope is headed: a real and promised day, when Christ returns and God makes new heavens and a new earth where righteousness is finally at home. The mockers say nothing ever changes, but the word that made the heavens is the word that guarantees the Day, and the delay you resent is mercy. Count His patience as salvation, build on what lasts, and keep growing until He comes.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 8
